releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 291: Fixed Private Locker PIN-screen control buttons so Pattern setup/change and Lock Off respond to taps; Pattern/Fingerprint removal and Fingerprint setup are enabled only when their prerequisites are available. Existing PIN verification, encrypted Locker data, Diary Lock and Note Lock remain unchanged.
